mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habit_executions (habit_id, occurrence_key, scheduled_at, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{habitId}, #{occurrenceKey}, #{scheduledAt}, 'SCHEDULED', 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (habit_id, occurrence_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM habit_executions WHERE habit_id = #{habitId} AND status IN ('DELIVERED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT e.* FROM habit_executions e JOIN habits h ON h.id = e.habit_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') ORDER BY e.scheduled_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM habit_executions WHERE completion_message_id = #{messageId} LIMIT 1
